verdict.rationale: monday.com documents native agents that users create by describing a workflow in plain words. Users delegate to them like teammates by messaging them, assigning them items, or @mentioning them, and the agents reply and update statuses and follow-ups. Admin scoping and per-action audit add governance. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks actually complete, and in-depth first-party docs (beyond marketing copy) on what the built-in assistant can do natively versus agents brought in from external providers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
Fire when an agent is messaged, assigned an item, or mentioned in an update.
